notes_for_editor: Thin sourcing. The provincial lookout record (year, type, height, elevation, active, weather station) and an undated photo credit are the only sources read. The AllTrails listing, whose snippet gives 1962, returned HTTP 403 and is not cited. The brief's access 'closed' is not supported by any source read; the provincial record gives ACCESS_MODE 'drive', so no access fact is recorded. The staffing sentence is Alberta-wide, not site-specific, so no staffing fact is recorded. The brief has no local_unit, so the place is Alberta only.
